Title: Simplify safe_join path checks

Description:
posixpath.normpath already collapses `..` segments, so the explicit `..` checks in safe_join are redundant. This makes the condition shorter and easier to read.

   174      :return: A safe path, otherwise ``None``.

   191          # Ensure we end up with ./path if directory="" is given,
   192          # otherwise the first untrusted part could become trusted.
   193          directory = "."
   194  
   195      parts = [directory]
   196  
   197      for part in untrusted:
   198          if not part:
   199              continue
   200  
   201          # normpath collapses "a/../b" style segments, so ".." can't survive it.
   202          part = posixpath.normpath(part)
   203  
   204          if (
   205              os.path.isabs(part)
   206              # ntpath.isabs doesn't catch this
   207              or part.startswith("/")
   208              or any(sep in part for sep in _os_alt_seps)
   209              or (
   210                  os.name == "nt"
   211                  and any(
   212                      p.partition(":")[0].partition(".")[0].strip().upper()
   213                      in _windows_device_files
   214                      for p in part.split("/")
   215                  )
   216              )
   217          ):

arguments.summary: The pull request removes explicit `..` and `../` checks from `safe_join` because `posixpath.normpath` already collapses `..` segments, so any path containing them cannot survive normalization unchanged (or produces a safe path without escaping the base directory via parent references).
